notes: SR1 asks that each identifier refer to a numeric elementary item (numeric edited allowed after GIVING, groups in CORRESPONDING); every probe of the read and the refuter for that test held. The doubt was SUBTRACT FUNCTION INTEGER (2.5) FROM N, which compiles and runs (+003). A numeric or integer function references a numeric elementary temporary item, so SR1 is met; what forbids the program at 85 is IV.4.3.4's separate rule that such functions appear only in arithmetic expressions. That defect is real but belongs to the IV.4.3.4 row.

next.reason: 1985: "In format 3, each identifier must refer to a group item."; 2023: "shall be alphanumeric group items, national group items, variable-length groups, or strongly-typed group items and shall not be described with level-number 66". Formats 1 and 2 keep the numeric and numeric-edited requirements. Format 3 now refuses level-66 items, which 1985 allowed, and names new group kinds.
